edges.meaning: Defines the full original eligible withdrawal-key universe independently of the original frontier.
Supplies the original design set for comparison; also permits monotonicity pruning.

required_state_retention: Restore the complete original record between trials. Each withdrawal changes its own support state, global frontier, cohort, year range and season-specific candidate events. Do not reuse original frontier intervals or minimum events as the universe of post-withdrawal choices.
retrieval_limit: Legal complete exports may make this entirely local computation. No unavoidable adaptive network sequence is claimed. All added dependencies need real counterfactual effects and independent empirical difficulty tests.

default_state.request: GET https://www.waterqualitydata.us/ with no search parameters
default_state.evidence_scope: actual HTML response only; no claim browser rendering or persisted client state examined

edge_interpretation: Computational/data/output dependencies only; listed order is not an unavoidable retrieval sequence. A full_design_set_change_test controls output eligibility, while dates, quarters and event candidates may be computed beforehand.

observed_legal_pruning.proof: Deletion only reduces quarter/year support and interval coverage. If every original frontier design retains its complete membership, it still dominates all formerly dominated designs. Only critical original-frontier support withdrawals need all-interval recomputation; previously dominated intervals must still be reconsidered for these trials.

redundant_event_removal: Every frontier-changing withdrawal destroys its station-year. A surviving interval either excludes that year or excludes that station from its cohort; explicitly removing that activity again from the final cohort/year pool adds no effect here.
